description:
Use this after get_filing_extract when the user wants the earlier state behind an order, capacity or similar event in a filing.

Returns, for one filing given by `news_id` (from get_stock_events), the event recorded from it, the earlier event it follows, what changed between them, related disclosures, the timeline of that group of filings, and the questions those filings leave open. It covers events such as orders, capacity, acquisitions, guidance, credit ratings, shareholding changes and resignations. The filing must have been read first with get_filing_extract. Only links that the filings themselves establish are reported, so an empty link means none was established, not that there is no history.

query.description: One company: NSE symbol, ISIN or BSE code, e.g. TCS, INE467B01029 or 532540. Always send it as `query` (not `symbol`).
